packageRules.description: compose-ai-tools is what this repo proves consumable: the ee.schimke.composeai:* artifacts (gradle/libs.versions.toml), the ee.schimke.composeai.preview plugin (scripting demo), and the apply composite action (apply-skip-render workflow) are all pinned in lockstep with a single upstream release. Group them so one Renovate PR bumps the whole set together and CI proves one coherent version — see the README 'Versioning' section.
